Used between repeated all-out sprints, CryoTherm Palm helped athletes:​
• Feel 60% cooler​
• Increase top speed by 2.45%​
• Reduce drop in sprint velocity by 4.7%.​

​The kind of edge that shows up when it matters most, later in the game, deeper into fatigue.​

*Based on a 3-week controlled study with 22 elite male soccer players (ages 17–19) using CryoTherm Palm for 2.5 minutes between sprint sets. Learn more at https://www.therabody.com/blogs/news/cryotherm-palm-study-improves-sprint-performance.

excluded.title: Nutrition: Myths and Truths | Technogym Podcast | Prof. Sarah Berry
excluded.description:
We’ve never more surrounded by nutrition advice as we are today. But how much of it can you actually trust?

In this episode, Professor Sarah Berry tackles the difference between what we think we know about nutrition and what the science says. Because what if many of the rules we follow and the “healthy” choices we make aren’t as clear-cut as they seem?

From the importance of the physical structure of what we eat to the influence of food labels, the conversation reveals how easily perception shapes our decisions about what and how to eat, often without us realizing it.

Along the way, ideas about what’s “good” or “bad”—from sweeteners to seed oils and even sparkling water—are revisited, showing how easily nutrition can be misunderstood when taken out of context.

Commonly asked questions are also addressed: like whether there are foods we should avoid at all costs, whether others can extend how long we live, and whether something as simple as refrigerating pasta can actually change how our body responds to it.

Watch the full episode to learn more.

If losing weight were simply a matter of eating less and moving more, why do so many people struggle to achieve lasting results?

In this episode, Professor Sarah Berry challenges some of the most common assumptions about weight loss and explores why our bodies don't always respond the way we expect.

The Story Behind the Name Concept2
excluded.description: The name "Concept2" reflects founders Dick and Pete Dreissigacker's design philosophy: the first, obvious idea (concept #1) is rarely the best solution. True innovation comes from exploring widely, testing rigorously, and choosing the second or third strongest solution.

excluded.title: Tinkerer's Evolution
excluded.description:
From a barn in Vermont to boathouses around the world, Concept2 oars have been continuously improved over the years. We call it the tinkerer’s evolution.
Since 1976, we’ve scrutinized every detail to build better oars. From materials and manufacturing processes, to reducing waste, and, of course, relentless testing. As Co-founder Dick Dreissigacker says, “The three principles of product design are: test, test, test.”
It’s this commitment to continuous refinement that drives us forward, and why we strive to create the best oars in the world for our customers and community.
